title: PHP-FPM pool tuning: six settings behind the 40-user wall
lede: Your traffic doubles and the site goes white. PHP-FPM workers are pinned at five, the queue is full, Apache is timing out. Here is the cheatsheet.
hero_alt: Overhead photo of paper PHP-FPM tuning worksheet, Apache 502 log sheet, brass FPM POOL plate, wax seal on bone linen.
